{{Top|leg}}
'''MMR''' was a slang term coined by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the food that they were fed while being held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''MMR'' was an acronym for "meals ready to regurgitate."
